column2: ENGLISH

I'm having dinner and plenty of wine with [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetTitledName] tonight. It's lovely, yet what charms me most is [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetFirstName] [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetHerselfHimself]. Why else would I not stop our conversation, which has slowly drifted towards almost heretical ideas, questioning the might of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]?
Why does [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] ignore us?
You think it's a great discussion, fuelled by wine or not.\n
We should not speak of this, [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetFirstName].
You would never question the authority of the gods.\n

Meeting with [From.GetTitledFirstName], I made sure to question the power of [From.GetHerHis] almighty [From.Religion.GetHighGodName] only cautiously... Thankfully, my carefully chosen words had the desired effect. From [From.GetHerHis] glittering eyes I got the distinct impression that [From.GetSheHe] enjoyed our little philosophical game.

Meeting with [From.GetTitledFirstName], I made sure to question the power of [From.GetHerHis] almighty [From.Religion.GetHighGodName] only cautiously... Regretfully, my words only irritated [From.GetHerHim]. From the steely look [From.GetSheHe] finally gave me, I should steer clear of [From.GetHerHim] for now.
A sensible [From.GetManWoman], [From.GetFirstName].
Continue your efforts to recruit §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! to [Root.Society.GetName].\n
I'm not sure [From.GetHerHis] sentiments were sincere...
You end your efforts to recruit §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! to [Root.Society.GetName].\n
Disappointing.

Walking the gardens of my [Root.GetCapitalHolding], I am joined by [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]. I find myself agreeing with much of what [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetSheHe] says, above all that prayer has never given me anything. Suddenly [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetSheHe] presses a little crystal phial of perfume into my hand. "Wear a drop of this, my [Root.GetLordLady]. You will see the world differently."
I'll keep it hidden, and I thank you, [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetFirstName].
You encourage the advances of §Y[cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]§!.\n
What is this? Some witch's potion?
You distance yourself from §Y[cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]§!.\n

I've arranged to run into [From.GetTitledFirstName] in the gardens of [From.GetHerHis] [From.GetCapitalHolding] today. [From.GetHerHisCap] face lights up when [From.GetSheHe] sees me, and we talk for hours. [From.GetSheHeCap] is wearing the perfume I gave [From.GetHerHim].

I've arranged to run into [From.GetTitledFirstName] in the gardens of [From.GetHerHis] [From.GetCapitalHolding] today. [From.GetHerHisCap] face darkens when I steer the talk back to the gods, and the phial I gave [From.GetHerHim] is nowhere to be seen. I doubt [From.GetSheHe] will listen to me again.
[From.GetSheHeCap] just needs one more little push.
Invite §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! to [Root.Society.GetName].
It's been interesting, but I don't think [From.GetSheHe] is ready for more.
A wasted effort. [From.GetFirstName] is locked in [From.GetHerHis] views.

What if I told you that all you have been taught is a lie? [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetFirstName] says, glancing around before pulling up [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetHerHis] sleeve to show the painted sigil of Atharti. "[Root.Religion.GetHighGodNameCap] gives you duty and denial. Atharti gives you everything else..."
You serve Atharti, then? Can you [Root.GetDWReasonToJoin]?
You ask §Y[cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]§! how to begin.\n
That is blasphemy, [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetFirstName]! Leave my sight before I call the guards!
You dismiss §Y[cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]'s§! offer and pretend it never happened.\n

When I showed [From.GetFirstName] the sigil on my arm, expecting the final hook to sink in, [From.GetSheHe] staggered back and made a sign against evil. "That is blasphemy, [Root.GetFirstName]! Leave my sight before I call the guards!" I left, reluctantly but quickly.
If I can't turn [From.GetHerHim], no one can.

When I showed [From.GetFirstName] the sigil on my arm, [From.GetSheHe] caught [From.GetHerHis] breath, and for a moment I worried. "You serve Atharti, then," [From.GetSheHe] says, eager and relieved. "Can you help me [From.GetDWReasonToJoin]?"
Patience, [From.GetSisterBrother]. We will speak again soon.
Write to the cult about §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]'s§! induction. [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetSocietyRank] §Y[cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetFirstName]§! will handle it from here.

We might... Give yourself to Atharti and she will grant you what [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] has always kept from us. Turning the little phial over in my fingers, I slowly nod. "Oh, and I think you will enjoy it..." [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetSheHe] adds with a knowing smile.
If there is any chance it will [Root.GetDWReasonToJoin], I will.
§Y[cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName]§! leaves you alone for now. The cult will be in touch.\n

I am not sure what has happened, but it has been a while since I heard from [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetBestName]. It's disappointing, as I was curious to see where our meetings were going... As I retire tonight, I feel sure that our time together has somehow ended too soon.
Something must have gone wrong.
You will have to wait for the Cult of Pleasure to find you again.

It has been some time since I heard from [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetTitledFirstName], and I have been turning [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetHerHis] words over in my mind. I have begun reading the old books on the forbidden gods of the elves, and the more I read, the smaller and more afraid the [Root.Religion.GetPriestTitle]s of the [Root.GetHouseOfWorship] seem.
Their lies are meant to hold us back!
You wait for further instructions.\n
I can't believe I have been so gullible.
I have been missing out...
Why must we always put the needs of others before our own...?

I found a strange sigil painted on my bedroom door this morning, in something red that smells of musk and roses. The guards swear no one came in during the night, and I dare not ask my [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] what it means. But I know it: the sigil of Atharti.
Of course, the bargain must be struck!
You paint the sigil of Atharti on your arm, just like the one you were shown.\n
My immortal soul... What if I'm wrong?
You order your servants to scrub the door clean, putting to rest any rumours this could stir up.\n

[Root.GetSisterBrotherCap] [Root.GetFirstName],
We have heard of your devotion and your wish to join in the worship of Atharti. Await the messenger.

May Atharti delight you.
Signed, [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName]
Finally.
You keep an eye out for "the messenger".\n

I've met an intriguing [From.GetManWoman] at court, a foreign envoy, apparently. We spoke at length about [Root.GetEducationalTopicPlural] today, and I was shocked when [From.GetFirstName] pulled up [From.GetHerHis] sleeve to show me the sigil of Atharti.

I've met an intriguing and hypnotically beautiful [From.GetManWoman] at court, a foreign envoy, apparently. We spoke at length about [Root.GetEducationalTopicPlural] today, and I was shocked when [From.GetFirstName] pulled up [From.GetHerHis] sleeve to show me the sigil of Atharti.
You're the messenger?

The [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetSocietyRank] smiles. "I am pleased to find you not only charming, [Root.GetFirstName], but curious. We prize those who want more from life than duty." The smile turns into a grin. "Let us see how much more you want..."
I... What do you need me to do?
§Y[cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetTitledFirstName]§! doesn't answer, but leads you by the hand to a quiet house in the city...\n

[cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetFirstName] leads me into the house, and I find myself eager to go in: sweet smoke, soft music, silks everywhere. Hooded, statuesque figures line the room, chanting together: "Pain is pleasure! Pleasure is pain!" [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetFirstName] pushes me down onto a soft bed and whispers, "Come, let us find out what you have been missing."
I like the sound of that!
Ooooh... yes.\n
I... I can't do this!
I can't do this! I'm married!
You refuse the rite and try to escape!\n

I am not sure what has happened, but it has been a while since I heard from [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetBestName]. It's disappointing, as I was curious to see where our meetings were going... As I retire tonight, I feel sure that our time together has somehow ended too soon.
Something must have gone wrong.

I take [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetFirstName] into my arms and lose myself in [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetHerHis] body for what feels like hours. When it is over, [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetSheHe] looks at me and says coyly, "Well? Did you find your induction... fitting?"
I wish you had found me sooner.
This was a necessary evil.
You become a member of the §YCult of Pleasure§! and secretly worship Atharti.\n

I pull away from [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetFirstName] and [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetHerHis] smile vanishes. "What are you doing?" "I'm sorry, [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetFirstName]. This is not my path." [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetSheHeCap] takes my hand again, but only kisses it gently before turning away. "Atharti will wait for you. I will remember you, [Root.GetFirstName]." [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetSheHeCap] hesitates, then adds: "I think you're special."

My eyes dart around the room. [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetFirstName] looks disappointed. My body finally unfreezes and I bolt for the door. "Brothers and sisters, after [Root.GetHerHim]! [Root.GetFirstName], we can talk about this!" What was I thinking, getting involved with the Cult of Pleasure?! As I flee, panic in my chest, I trip and fall hard.

My eyes dart around the room. [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetFirstName] rolls [cult_of_pleasure_inductor.GetHerHis] eyes as I bolt for the door. "Brothers and sisters, see that [Root.GetSheHe] doesn't do anything foolish." I don't make it far before a thin blade slides between my ribs.
[Root.Religion.GetHighGodNameCap] may punish me for it, but I'll remember you, too.
With help from your most loyal guards, the cultists are quietly escorted out of your [Root.GetCapitalHolding]. "Lost travellers," you explain.\n
Guards! GUAAARDS!!!
The cultists escape from your [Root.GetCapitalHolding].\nYou are injured in the chaos.\n
This is... not... good.
The cultists escape from your [Root.GetCapitalHolding], and you are killed in the chaos.\n

The Cult of Pleasure might not be as bad as I thought, I muse. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened had I joined them, and where [cult_of_pleasure_recruiter.GetFirstName] has gone. Somewhere warm and sinful, surely.
My time is better spent far away from them.
§Y[Root.GetTitledFirstName]§! will never worship Atharti.\n

Atharti smiles on you, [Root.GetSocietyRank] [Root.GetFirstName].
The recruit you found for us, [cult_of_pleasure_recruit.GetTitledFirstName], has now been inducted into our circle, and enjoyed every moment of it. This will not be forgotten.

Signed, Grand Master [From.GetFirstName]

Atharti is displeased, [Root.GetSocietyRank] [Root.GetFirstName].
The recruit you found for us, [cult_of_pleasure_recruit.GetTitledFirstName], has proven a disaster. We spent much effort to bring [cult_of_pleasure_recruit.GetHerHim] in, all for nothing. This lack of judgement will be remembered.

Signed, Grand Master [From.GetFirstName]
Excellent.
Curses!

[Root.GetSisterBrotherCap] [Root.GetFirstName],

The one who was to bring you to us can no longer do so. Your longing has not gone unnoticed. If you still wish it, our doors are open: come to us, take the sigil of Atharti, and taste what the gods have kept from you.

Signed, [From.GetSocietyRank] [From.GetFirstName]
I accept. May Atharti delight me.
I have changed my mind.

Grand Master,

It is done. [pleasure_knife_target.GetTitledName] will trouble you no more. [pleasure_knife.GetFirstName] sends [pleasure_knife.GetHerHis] regards, and asks only that you remember whose hand held the knife.

In Atharti's name.
Sweet news.

Grand Master,

I have failed you. [pleasure_knife_target.GetTitledName] lives: the blade slipped, the guards came, and I barely got away. I await your punishment, and I hope it is a pleasant one.

[pleasure_knife.GetFirstName]

Grand Master,

I have failed you. [pleasure_knife_target.GetTitledName] lives, and worse, saw my face before I fled. [pleasure_knife_target.GetSheHeCap] knows I tried to kill [pleasure_knife_target.GetHerHim]. I await your punishment, and I hope it is a pleasant one.

[pleasure_knife.GetFirstName]
Useless.
